answer_1.quote: We propose MT-RAIG BENCH, aiming to measure the system's ability on Retrieval-Augmented Insight Generation over Multiple-Tables... insight i is generated by grounding it on the retrieved Tq.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the insight generation performance using SacreBLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, BERTScore, A3CU, TAPAS-Acc, G-Eval, and our proposed MT-RAIG EVAL.

answer_3.quote: We implement MT-RAIG EVAL on the top of gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18... G-Eval assesses the quality of generated text based on specific evaluation criteria using LLMs.

answer_4.quote: Two graduate students participated as annotators... human evaluators are then tasked with annotating each pair across two dimensions – faithfulness and completeness – selecting win, tie, or loss.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare pairs of generated insights and select a win/tie/loss label for each of the two dimensions (faithfulness and completeness).
